about_the_game:
Key Gameplay

  • Trade Between Worlds: Buy goods from the real world, then cross over to a fantasy realm to sell them to NPCs at a high markup. Understanding an item's rarity and an NPC's preferences is key to your success.

  • A 30-Day Time Limit: You have exactly 30 days to play. Carefully plan your inventory for the next day's sales and execute an efficient trading strategy. You can only advance to the next day by sleeping, which also lets you receive your ordered packages.

  • Your Mission: Your ultimate goal is to pay off the massive debt from a housing scam. The gold you earn in the fantasy world can be exchanged for real-world currency.

  • First-Person View: Experience the fantasy and real worlds through a captivating first-person perspective. The stylized low-poly graphics will make you feel like a merchant on a unique journey.

Features

  • A Unique Economic System: Maximize your profit by balancing the purchase prices of goods in the real world, the selling prices in the fantasy world, and the exchange rate of currencies.

  • Interact with Diverse NPCs: Chat with the colorful cast of NPCs in the other world. By understanding their tastes, you can sell your items for a higher price. As you trade with them, new items will appear in the village, creating more opportunities for you.

  • A Relaxing and Strategic Experience: There is no combat or danger. The game is all about trading and strategy. This is the perfect game for players who enjoy a cozy experience that still challenges their minds.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Trapped by a massive ₩200,000,000 debt from a housing scam, you discover a mysterious portal to the otherworld. Your mission: buy goods in the real world, sell them for huge profits in the otherworld, and pay off your debt. You only have 30 days to earn it all back and start a new life!
